        avg_id_weight = 0.2 * (AVG / (CUR + 1)) * (1 + urgency * 0.7) * (1 - (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.2)
    else:
        avg_id_weight = 0.2 * (AVG / (CUR + 10)) * (1 - urgency * 0.7) * (1 + (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.2)

    # Future blocking: curvature-adjusted exponential suppression based on RI and stack height
    if SH - EMP > 0:
        future_blocking_weight = 0.15 * (RI / (SH - EMP + 1)) * math.exp(-RI * urgency / 35) * (1 + urgency) * (1 - (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.15)
    else:
        future_blocking_weight = 0.15 * (RI / 2) * math.exp(-RI * urgency / 35) * (1 - urgency) * (1 + (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.15)

    # Difference weight: prioritize stacks that don't contain smaller IDs, adjusted with curvature-aware suppression
    diff_weight = 0.1 * ((1e9 - DIFF) / (1e9 + 1)) * (1 - urgency * 0.2) * (1 + (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.05) if DIFF < 1e9 else 0.1 * (1 - urgency * 0.2)

    # Stack height penalty: curvature-adaptive urgency-aware penalty with lookahead curvature
    stack_height_weight = 0.1 * (SH / 85) * (1 + urgency) * math.exp(-SH / (40 + 5 * (1 - urgency))) * (1 - (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.15)

    # Future blocking interference: entropy-aware non-linear suppression with curvature adjustment
    interference_density = (RI + 1) * (1 + (AVG - CUR) / 15) * (1 - urgency) * (1 + (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.1)
    interference_penalty = 0.1 * interference_density * math.exp(-SH / (35 + 5 * (1 - urgency))) * (1 - (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.1)

    # Entropy-aware suppression: curvature-based dispersion suppression with lookahead curvature
    if SH - EMP > 0:
        # Estimate dispersion using curvature-adaptive urgency-weighted squared distance
        id_dispersion = 1 + (AVG - CUR) ** 2 * math.exp(-RI * (1 - urgency) / 25) * (1 + (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.25)
        curvature_factor = 1 + math.log(1 + id_dispersion) * (1 - urgency) * (1 - (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.1)
        entropy_penalty = 0.12 * (1 / (1 + id_dispersion)) * curvature_factor
    else:
        entropy_penalty = 0.12 * 0.5 * (1 + urgency * 0.1) * (1 + (DIFF / 1e9) * 0.1)

    # Final priority score: sum of all components
    priority = free_space_weight + avg_id_weight + future_blocking_weight + diff_weight + stack_height_weight + interference_penalty + entropy_penalty
    return priority
